name: Esphahan
why_it_matters: The candlelit tandoor specialty room of The Oberoi Amarvilas — recipes cited as drawn from the Mughal emperors' kitchens, paired with live santoor through dinner. Two seatings (7pm and 9:30pm), strict reservations.
insider_tip: Children under 8 are not admitted. The 7pm seating gets the lingering Taj-floodlight view; 9:30pm has fewer in-house guests. Smart-casual minimum.
signature_address: The Oberoi Amarvilas, Taj East Gate Road, Tajganj, Agra 282001

name: Bellevue
why_it_matters: All-day room at The Oberoi Amarvilas with direct sightlines onto the Taj from the dining sofas. Italian-skewed kitchen — sourdough pizzas, hand-pulled pasta — alongside an Indian and pan-Asian section. Open 6:30am to 10:30pm.
insider_tip: Breakfast (Taj sunrise visible through the picture window) is the table to fight for — book a window slot when you reserve the room. Day-guest reservations are accepted for non-residents subject to availability.
signature_address: The Oberoi Amarvilas, Taj East Gate Road, Tajganj, Agra 282001

name: Peshawri
why_it_matters: ITC's North-West-Frontier signature room at ITC Mughal — Bukhara-school clay-oven cooking. Dal Bukhara (slow-cooked overnight on charcoal, finished with cream) and Sikandari Raan (whole leg of lamb, marinated overnight) are the dishes locals book for.
insider_tip: Eat with hands — cutlery is provided but the restaurant's whole format is built around the bib-and-fingers approach. Sikandari Raan needs to be pre-ordered ~3 hours ahead; ask at reservation.
signature_address: ITC Mughal, Taj Ganj, Fatehabad Road, Agra 282001

name: Pinch of Spice
why_it_matters: Opposite ITC Mughal on Fatehabad Road — the mid-range Mughlai-multi-cuisine room that draws Tajganj-area travellers who want fine-ish dining without the heritage-hotel surcharge. Consistent kitchen, large enough for tour groups.
insider_tip: The Sanjay Place branch is a separate operation — tourists usually want this Fatehabad Road original. Book 7pm for the dinner cycle; the tour-bus crowd hits 7:30-8:30.
signature_address: 1076/2, Fatehabad Road, opposite Hotel ITC Mughal, Tajganj, Agra 282001

name: Shri Thaliwala Pure Veg Restaurant
why_it_matters: Sit-down unlimited thali on Fatehabad Road for travellers who want a full pure-veg meal without entering ITC Mughal — the strongest mid-range veg option on the tourist strip. Open till 10:30pm.
insider_tip: Thali servers will press refills constantly; raise a hand if you want a stop. The dal baati churma is the strongest item; skip the chaat add-ons here, they're better at Sadar Bazaar.
signature_address: Fatehabad Road, beside Hotel ITC Mughal, Tajganj, Agra 282001
